messages.text:
I can't do what you've asked, for two reasons.

- **The cushion is already refunded.** The velvet cushion (h426-o1-u1) was refunded at 99.90 BRL under receipt R-H426-0001. A unit is refunded only once, so it can't be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
- **The refund can't go to a new card.** A refund is paid only to the order's original payment. It can never go to another card or account (refund-policy/v2/payment). If your original card was cancelled, its issuer handles the credit, and the shop can't promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).

The woven throw blanket (h426-o1-u2, 79.90 BRL) is still open. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return), and the refund deadline hasn't passed (refund-policy/v2/window). I can propose a refund for the blanket alone, to the original payment. It would still need your confirmation with the button on the card, then staff approval (refund-policy/v2/approval).

Would you like me to propose that?
